buildCommand: npm run db:deploy || echo "[beluga] The database setup above failed; the app still builds."; npm run build
ignoreCommand: [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] || exit 1; files=$(git diff --name-only "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD) || exit 1; [ -n "$files" ] || exit 1; ! printf '%s\n' "$files" | grep -qvE '^(docs/|LICENSE$)|\.md$'
